balls.text: well bowled, Hodge gets front leg away again, Kallis follows him with one angled in full, and Hodge can only dig it out to deep square
swung through square leg, and they come back for the secon
Sreesanth makes room and goes for glory, an inside edge onto pad is his reward, and Hodge regains strike again
high full toss, pulled straight to deep square leg, it's called a no-ball for height, just above the waist
Sreesanth dances out and has a huge swing, can't connect, and Hodge rushes through for a bye

full and slogged out to deep midwicket, Hodge not willing to risk the second, Yagnik hurtling back, he realises Hodge is not interested, and keeps running, and walks back to the dressing room as the throw arrives at the keeper's end
yorker inches outside off, but Hodge creates some room with the front leg out of the way and squeezes it between short third man and backward point
now he gets the reverse sweep going to a full one outside off, successive fours, off Narine, short third man helpless as it races fine past him
length ball, Yagnik bends the knee and connects with the slog-sweep, flat and well over deep midwicket's jump
carrom ball on off, guided to point for one
that spun in and bounced, completely cramping Hodge, but the veteran adjusts superbly, steering it very late past the keeper
he tries to scoop Narine past short fine now, it is on the pads too, but he hasn;t got enough sting on it
short and spinning across the left-hander, he slaps it wide of the sweeper for a couple
misses this time, makes room to leg, Lee bangs it in short outside off, and Hodge fails to connect with the swing
Hodge squeezes in the boundary, clears front leg again, creates space and swats a back of a length ball between deep midwicket and long on
he walked a mile outside off stump and tried to ramp it over short fine leg, the length ball hit his thigh pad and popped up in that region
scoops it off the pad over midwicket, man in the deep runs around to field
clears front leg and slogs a full delivery from the stumps to deep midwicket
they are still bouncing from a good length, widish, he backs away and swings hard, misses
tries to arch back and steer it over the keeper but misses the short ball
pulls a high full toss to deep midwicket
dropped softly to the off side, Morgan runs in from extra cover and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's but Yagnik's made it with a dive
gets it off the pads but not much pace on it, and short fine leg fields
goes deep and runs it from close to off down to third man
driven to extra cover off the front foot
drills a full one back to the bowler
pushes a flighted one to extra cover
Bisla breaks the stumps and runs towards the bowler, appealing loudly, Cooper misses the sweep to an offbreak, and replays show the back foot is on the line, quick work from Bisla
pushes a full delivery to extra cover
Rahane walks, tries to run it to third man, it is the one that goes away from the right-hander, keeper takes it and goes up immediately, and Rahane walks instantly
pushes a fullish delivery wide of the sweeper who keeps them to one
down to third man for a single
dismissed, cracking drive from Hodge, pitched up, he helps himself with a full-blooded swing, to the deep extra cover rope
bends and opens the face to steer it to third man, was aiming to be much squarer in the gap
backs away and ends up chopping it towards point
nice reply, hits him on the pads with an incoming length ball, appeal for lbw turned down
outstanding timing, just outstanding, Shami's pitched it up, Rahane's come forward and pushed it in the air, it's gone like a missile high over extra cover, way into the crowd
slow on the pads, turned wide of short fine
nice, draws him forward with a fuller length and moves it away, Rahane beaten as he tries to run it to third man
comes in, off the pad to short fine leg
hodge is ready for the slow, back of a length sitter-up, drags a pull easily over midwicket
92.4 kph says speed gun, Rahane waits and waits and flays it down to long on
not much pace to do much with, slaps a length ball back to the bowler
leading edge to the sweeper as he tries to turn it to leg off the pads
Hodge gets another one through point, length from Shukla, widish, and he bangs the bat hard down on it, no chance for backward point
angled in fullish, nudged square on the leg side, Hodge makes it back for the second
pushed off the front foot to long on
walks out and swings at a length ball, edges it down to third man
another dot ball, straightens outside off, Rahane steers it to point
forward now and pushes it softly to the bowler, not taking chances against Narine
good length, on off, he is back and across to block to the bowler
comes forward to one floated up full, inside edged to square leg
quicker and fuller and moving away outside off, Hodge is beaten as he goes after it
forward to a tossed up ball and runs it to third man
fine line, sharp good length ball no far from off, Hodge flags it through
pitched up, towards the stumps, patted down the pitch
straight and rising outside off, left alone
first ball he gets some width and runs a cut past backward point and wide of third man
that is gone, Aleem Dar raises the finger immediately, and Shukla has struck first ball, with one angled in, Binny caught in the crease as it nipped in further
cautious in coming forward now, runs it down to third man
hello, that has taken off from a good length, fortunately for Binny it was moving away outside off, he was able to withdraw the bat
crashed over extra cover. Binny doing it again for RR, Bhatia offers width at slow pace, and Binny gets to the line to send it soaring
that came in, from a length, around off stump, Binny was coming forward and adjusts to turn it to leg
slight width, and he opens the face into the gap past short third man
slower one cutting away from Bhatia, dabbed to short third
wide, short, and he pings the deep point boundary with a well-placed cut
tries to hook a sharp bouncer dug into the him, too quick for him
dabbed down to third man again
lifts from back of a length, he rides the bounce, and runs it down to third man
drives but off the inner part of the bat, straight back to the bowler
opens the face to run a widish length ball to third man
this bounced too, from a good length, Binny surprised as he comes forward to block
Bhatia's broken through, straight length ball on the stumps, Dravid reaches forward eyeing midwicket, big gap between bat and pad and the ball sneaks through
this comes in now and bounces on Rahane, got quite big on him in the end, he angles it off the glove to short third
really slow from Bhatia, widish, Dravid has to wait an age for it to arrive and is disappointed that he's bashed it straight to the sweeper
pops it in the air as he tries to punch down to long off, no harm done in the end as it's wide of extra cover
good length, worked off the pad through square leg
squeezed past point for a single
slower one, pitched up, Dravid has stretched the front foot out to the line, and driven it neatly past extra cover, no chance for the man sweeping
crisp punch off the back foot, the kind of noise that reverberates around the ground, sweeper is in place though
misses one on the pad again, takes the leg bye
forward to drive to extra cover
back of a length, pushed to mid off
now Rahane lunges out and slogs, cleanly over midwicket
this rushes in from a length, he rocks back and opens the face, he's timed it well, but Gambhir is quick to dive to his left at point
right forward again to defend to the bowler with a straight bat
lunges forward and turns an tossed up offspinner past short midwicket's dive
good length and straightish, punched off the back foot to covers
tossed up and turning in from outside off, nudged off the front foot to short fine
this time he makes sure another one on the pads does not go unpunished, sends it racing into the fine leg rope with a quick turn of the wrists
this came in a tad from back of a length, Dravid was making some room on leg, and adjusted to push to covers
width for the cut, and Dravid delays the stroke for an instant to get the placement to backward point's left, but the fielder reaches there with a dive
slower one now, Dravid goes reaching forward, waits and plays it out to point
misses this full one on the pad, and bangs wrist onto bat in disappointment
tests Dravid with a pitched up ball that is angled in and then holds the line, Dravid carefully follows the line and leans forward to block
beaten again, moving away from a good length, Rahane tries a weak punch off the back foot
reaching forward to the line of a fullish one, pushes it to extra cover
wide line from KKR once again, Rahane eyes the cover region but misses this time
he tried this against Lee, and does it now again, widish length ball swinging away, Rahane waits for it, goes forward, bends, opens the face and runs it to the third man rope
stand and smash, Rahane gets a widish back of a length ball and sends it rocketing past cover
he's just had a loose waft at this length ball not far from off, inside edge onto pad
wide again from Lee, Rahane reaches for it and steers it in the air down to third man, that flew to the fielder, pace in the desert, well, on the edge of it
rather too wide from Lee, and moving further away, Dravid stretches to it and awkwardly cuts, backward point dives and takes pace off it
pitched up towards the stumps Dravid pats it to mid on
he goes for the shot again, but this time, he's hit it straight to short extra cover, didn't get hold of it, got it off the toe end
Watson likes the pace onto his bat, he plants front foot forward and across, and blasts a widish length ball over extra cover
that's got to be very close, Aleem Dar ingnores Lee's shout, and signals leg bye, Rahane was struck quite high with the incoming length ball, replays show
Watson plonks front foot out and flays this length ball down the ground, but mid off is in the way
into the pads now, and Rahane, in bread-and-butter fashion, turns it behind square leg
punched solidly, ball is coming on, and there should be lots of these today, cover saves the four with a dive

wow, confusion, collision, Rahane just about manages to reach the other end with a slide on one leg, nudged to leg, they take off, first Rahane has to get past the bowler, who is rushing towards the ball, then Watson crashes into him, well done, little Rahane, for recovering from that
angled in, straightening outside off, Rahane on the back foot and softly runs it towards point, they take the single after considerable pondering
pitched up, swinging away widish, Rahane cannot connect as he reaches out
the ball is flying around here, short of a length, zipping away, Watson tries to upper cut, misses
right on middle and off, 141.4 kph, says the speed gun, warning: believe it at your own peril, Watson bends low to block
tries to drive a straight length ball, and mistimes it off the inner part of the blade, there is some pace in this surface
quick, short, sharp from Lee, but again moving down the leg side
short and angled down leg, Watson revs up for the pull, but he's not found much connection on that, just enough to be denied the wide call, ball goes on the bounce to the keeper
loud, long lbw appeal from Lee, that has nipped in from back of a length and caught Watson high above the knee roll, going down leg, and too high
pitched up around middle and leg, Watson brings bat around pad to work it down to mid on
an offcutter, a hoick, a skier, Rahane comes in from deep midwicket, accepts it, and throws it in the air, Rajasthan start with a win at Sawai Mansingh
no pace to work with, Narine backs to leg, and slaps it to extra cover
pitched up, slogged on the bounce to long off
yorker, right on target, keeper dives and collects down leg as Shami misses
turned off the pad through square leg
game, set, match, Kevon Cooper, slow offcutter, to the man who was swiping Shaun Tait for sixes, Morgan on a knee outside off, the scoop in mind, gets an inside edge onto stumps
slammed through midwicket, long on a tad slow to run in and get the ball back to the bowler, and Morgan has rushed back for the second, and taken strike for the next over
tries to rush across and scoop over short fine, can;t get hold of it, it pops up on off towards the keeper
can't connect with a full and wide ball
ho ho, Eoin Morgan, gets to fifty with a bent knee pick-up off his pads to a shortish ball, fine leg is in, even if he would have been on the rope, that would have made no difference, perfect timing
low full toss, he backs away and slams it to long off
widish length ball, Morgan has a swipe at it, drags it past midwicket, and it almost runs into the boundary, man runs across and slides to haul it back in, Morgan off strike with a third
another swipe eyeing deep square leg, but he cannot connect, Cooper bowls a tight over full of slower ones
heaves a day too soon at a length ball, which bounces over the stumps
right on middle stump, good length, Morgan can;t get under that, he dabs it to short third man
pitched up, he swings violently and hits it down to long off
can;t find pace to time the cut, too close too, chops it towards point
slow length ball, Morgan helps it past short fine for a couple
not far from off stump, not far from the outside edge, sharp length ball zooms past Shami's flail
tries to work it to leg, leading edge falls short of point
length ball on off, Morgan runs it deftly to third man
Lee swings, and connects, and connects big, that looks like it's headed for six, but this is not a small outfield, and long on is waiting on the edge of the boundary
Lee shows RR need to watch out at both ends, flicks a length ball angled in, and beats deep square leg's dive
right on off stump, pitched up, Lee presses into a push to short extra
more runs, leg side from Tait, and Mogan gets something on it to beat fine leg
quick full toss, on the pads, Morgan reacts nicely to flick it over midwicket's jump
overpitched on the stumps, Lee makes some room and drills it past short extra cover's dive which takes pace off it, long off runs in
very full, 143.6 kph, Lee cannot connect
slower length ball to fellow Aussie quick, Lee pats it away

Tait with the breakthrough right away, short, Bhatia thumps a flat pull off the middle of the bat, but straight for a high catch to deep midwicket, unfortunate end for Bhatia, he absolutely creamed that one
slower one, moving away as Morgan lunges forward, beats the edge, bounces in front of the keeper, that has been rare today
bends the knee for the cut and is beaten by a length ball
full, wide, too wide, some change in momentum now, Morgan the man
cracker, Morgan stepping it up, on the front foot and shovels a pitched up delivery high over long off
pushed through vacant midwicket, and they come back for the second
straight length ball around off, he is across to block solidly
and Morgan has drilled this right between extra cover and mid off, overpitched, outside off, Morgan in position to put it away
worked through square leg off the pad
that is placed neatly, slightly short, and Bhatia drags it from outside off with a swat to the deep midwicket rope
back of a length, pushed down to long on
angled in to middle and leg, bat around front pad to work it through square leg
pushes a length ball to the sweeper
Morgan gets hold of one finally, short and into the pads, he swivels and sends it soaring over the fine leg boundary with a swift pull
slashes hard, it flies on the bounce to third man, give me this pitch any day, in the IPL
bends the knee and tries to cut, chops it into the pitch
not much room, good length, played out to point
runs it down to third man past backward point's dive
sloppy from Trivedi, Bhatia guides it past point, Trivedi labouring in from third man, gets a hand to it and helps it into the rope
very full outside off, moving away, he reaches out to it and is beaten
holes out to long on, pitched up, he has a go at it, hasn;t timed it at all, and long on settles under the skier
can't put bat to ball, cramped for room with one angled in to leg, and tries to swing it awkwardly
backs away and hacks at a short of a length ball, misses
slow length ball, worked in front of square leg, man runs in from the deep and keeps them to one
hit on the body with some inward shape and lots of bounce, ball runs towards slip
straight and good length on the stumps, pushed to the bowler
straightens from a length outside off and beats the outside edge
goes across and turns it down to fine leg
and again, pitched up and angled across him, Morgan can;t connect with the drive
appeal for leg before, Morgan struck in front of the stumps, but he's on the walk across and a long way down, that pitched in line and swung in
wide, full, Morgan out to have a big drive at it, beaten
nips in from wide outside off, chopped straight to point
right on middle stump, lovely, all-out seam attack dominating a powerful line-up in a T20, defended to the bowler

dropped, difficult chance at wide slip, they are flying all around, Morgan walking down and trying to turn it to leg, the length ball takes the edge and flies to Watson's right, he goes flying but out she pops
cut straight to point
bat and pad as he attempts an extra cover drive
pitched up to the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
runs it down to third man
wider, swinging away, he goes after it, and misses, quite daft
you felt this was coming, YK is stuck in the crease and has a feeble waft at a widish length ball outside off, and feathers it through to the keeper
walks out and turns it from outside off to mid on, who cannot pick it up cleanly and it is an easy single in the end
hit high on the pad on the forward push, outside off, the bounce again
right forward, bat and pad together, to block a length ball to off

Trivedi with another wicket, this was never going to be an easy chase, it isn't now, Gambhir charging down the pitch and having a go at a length ball, thick edge to the keeper's left and he takes the sharp chance with a leap
worked off the pad behind square leg
dabs at a length ball going away from him, beaten
back of a length, thick inside edge to thigh pad and they take the single as the ball rolls square on off

given right away, Trivedi strikes first ball, pitched up on off stump, Tiwary all too eager to work it to leg, but he has too much work to do to bring bat around front pad, misses, and is hit in front of middle, goner
pushed in front of cover for a quick single, bowler goes charging after it
slower one from Cooper, gambhir waits and dabs it to third man
width, slapped away to point, bursts past him, cover tidies up
coming in to the batsman, cramped for room, plays it to leg
top-edge, falls in vacant land, bowler races towards square leg, but it comes down in front of him, Gambhir  going for the pull, and edging it onto the helmet grille and into the sky
Gambhir charges out first ball seeing the slower bowler, but there is lots of bounce from back of a length, and Gambhir is beaten
short of a length, he hops and works it behind square again
on middle, worked neatly behind square, Tait gets the massive frame down to stop it at short fine leg
pushes at a short of a length ball and gets it down to third man
full on the stumps, chipped awkwardly in the air, out of the reach of mid on, and it runs into the boundary
beside the line of a short of a length ball and squeezes it wide of point, Tait at third man scrambles to his right and somehow stops it
pitched up and driven, but Cooper gets in the way to his right at short extra
that is fast, clocked at 150.1 kph, almost reaches the keeper even as Gamhir is going through the motions of his attempted flash outside off
goes reaching for a wide and full one, in the air but safely short of third man
sharp, and short of a length at 149 kph, Tiwary runs it to point
goes back and Gambhir-dabsTM a length ball to third man
stabs a good length widish ball down to third man, and gets off strike
uncertain, he's prone to that, Tiwary, prods at an outswinger and is beaten
goes for the inswinging yorker, not quite there, Gambhir pushes it to mid on
pushes a good length delivery on off to point
into the pads, Tiwary likes the leg side, he clips it wide of square leg, who dives and takes some pace off it
he's taken out the great man first ball, and is over the moon, Kallis wafting needlessly at a widish short of a length ball, thick edge to the keeper
short and down the leg side at 142.6 kph
Bisla backs away outside leg, the length ball is angled in on to the stumps, Bisla misses, Shukla hits, that was quick from the bowler, and weird from the batsman
pegs Gambhir back with a short of a length delivery into the body, fended into the leg side
full toss swinging in, hit to mid on
bouncer, Gambhir crouches under, keeper jumps to take it
back of a length, straightens on the stumps and cramps him for room, 149.7 kph, guided to point from the crease
fast full toss, 147.4 kph, on off, Gambhir hits it on the bounce to cover
wafts at an away going length ball, underedges it on the bounce to second slip, they steal a single as the ball rolls away
lovely, 146.8 kph, angled in on a length, and swerving away close to off, Bisla beaten on the back foot prod
outswinger, past the attempted drive, called wide, tight call
and he sends it down the leg side with some inswing on a good length
chops a punch into the ground as he opens the face to a length ball, point fields
he gets it outside off now, but too far outside, Gambhir misses again, but he gets another ball
and again onto the pads, clipped past short fine leg, deep square runs around, wrong lines largely from Sreesanth so far
wow, Gambhir's walked out and murdered a length ball high over deep square leg
angled across, good length, Gambir drives, in the air
straightening from a length, but on the pads, and Gambhir turns it wide of fine leg, where tait runs across and makes a mess of it
short of a length, nipping in, but onto the pad, and rolls behind square leg
